entry.title: REA (open-source contribution)
entry.summary: Extending REA's ELF layout analysis, an MCP reverse-engineering tool, from x86-64 to eight CPU architectures.

entry.title: Canadian Defence Hardware Program
entry.summary: Eleven hands-on hardware builds across sky, water, and ground, each mapped to a stated Defence Drone Initiative or Army MINERVA requirement, full BOMs, prices, step-by-step build guides, and bench photos.

entry.title: Sky: Passive Aerial Early-Warning Node
entry.summary: Receive-only passive radar on a KrakenSDR 5-channel coherent SDR: FM/TV broadcast reflections off aircraft, range-Doppler processing with pyAPRiL, scored against an RTL-SDR ADS-B ground-truth receiver.

entry.title: Water: Passive Acoustic Vessel Monitor
entry.summary: Solar-powered hydrophone node classifying passing vessels from underwater sound, with an RTL-SDR AIS receiver as ground truth and a dock-to-recharge extension.

entry.title: Ground: Seismic & Acoustic Perimeter Mesh
entry.summary: Solar 915 MHz LoRa mesh of ESP32 nodes with ADXL355 accelerometers and geophones, classifying vehicles vs footsteps vs wind at the edge and reporting signed detections.

entry.title: GPS-Denied Navigation Rover
entry.summary: ROS 2 rover fusing wheel odometry, BNO085 IMU, and 2D LiDAR with an Extended Kalman Filter; GNSS gets switched off and position drift is measured against a u-blox ground-truth track.

entry.title: Convoy-Following Robots on a Degraded Mesh
entry.summary: Two rovers convoy behind a lead vehicle over a 915 MHz LoRa / Wi-Fi mesh, hold formation through induced link drops, and recover on reconnect, the resupply-convoy DDIL problem at bench scale.

entry.title: Passive Acoustic Drone Detector
entry.summary: MEMS microphone array on a Raspberry Pi detecting rotor harmonics, rejecting birds and aircraft, and estimating direction of arrival by beamforming, emits nothing, only detects.

entry.title: Thermal Search-and-Rescue Drone
entry.summary: X500-class quadcopter with a FLIR Lepton thermal camera and Hailo AI HAT+ edge detection finding people in snow and brush, pushing georeferenced detections to a live map.

entry.title: Cold-Soak Battery Characterization Rig
entry.summary: Heated, instrumented drone battery bay tested in a lab freezer and real Canadian winter, runtime, voltage sag, and failure modes logged against temperature as a published dataset.

entry.title: Secure Robot-Fleet Updates

entry.title: Mini Airspace Deconfliction Manager

entry.title: Multi-Domain Common Operating Picture
